summary: Flow-memory hydrology stitched across chunks, seepage-aware lakes and cave ceilings, refreshed world-map generation signature, and stricter protobuf descriptor origin guards.

core.name: Flow-memory hydrology
core.description: Blend hydrology + flow memory with watershed edge repair so rivers, lakes, and caves share continuous masks on server and Unity previews.

core.name: World-map signature sync
core.description: Hash world-config + map-control inputs into a generation signature so server responses and Unity previews reload safely when configs change.

core.name: Protobuf descriptor origin guard
core.description: Assert EnhancedMinecraft bindings resolve from the expected generated assembly/descriptor and flag stale using directives or mismatched handlers early.

content.name: River edge repair
content.description: Flow-shadowed meanders, watershed edge blending, and confluence boosts keep river banks stitched and width stable near chunk seams.

content.name: Lake seepage & outflow
content.description: Lake basins use flow seepage, rim erosion, and watershed repair to keep wetlands and outflow channels continuous across chunk borders.

content.name: Moisture-aware cave ceilings
content.description: Cave thresholds account for flow shadow, hydrology gradients, and ceiling moisture clamps so seams stay sealed under rivers/lakes.

utilities.name: Config JSON alignment
utilities.description: Keep world/map-control/enhanced-terrain JSON in sync between server and StreamingAssets with generation signatures for cache safety.

utilities.name: Data-driven worldgen knobs
utilities.description: Expose river/lake/cave seam + seepage + flow memory tuning via JSON so both server and client previews stay data-driven.

utilities.name: Build + protobuf validation
utilities.description: Run SharedProtocol/GameServer builds plus verify_protobuf to ensure generated DTOs and handlers line up before deploy.
